commands.name: Create a repository
commands.description: Create a new Git repository in the current directory.

commands.name: Clone a repository
commands.description: Copy a remote repository to this computer.

commands.name: Show Git version
commands.description: Print the installed Git version.

commands.name: Open Git help
commands.description: Show documentation for a Git command.

commands.name: Check repository status
commands.description: Show the current branch and changed files.

commands.name: Set commit author name
commands.description: Set the name recorded in your commits.

commands.name: Set commit author email
commands.description: Set the email recorded in your commits.

commands.name: List Git settings
commands.description: Show active Git settings and the files they came from.

commands.name: Stage a file
commands.description: Stage a file for the next commit.

commands.name: Stage all changes
commands.description: Stage all added, changed, and deleted files.

commands.name: Stage selected changes
commands.description: Review and stage individual change hunks interactively.

commands.name: Discard unstaged file changes
commands.description: Restore a file from the index and discard its unstaged edits.

commands.name: Unstage a file
commands.description: Remove a file from the staging area while keeping its working changes.

commands.name: Remove a tracked file
commands.description: Delete a file and stage its removal.

commands.name: Rename a tracked file
commands.description: Move or rename a file and stage the change.

commands.name: Show unstaged changes
commands.description: Show changes in the working tree that are not staged.

commands.name: Show staged changes
commands.description: Review changes staged for the next commit.

commands.name: Compare two branches
commands.description: Show changes introduced by a branch since it diverged from its base.

commands.name: Summarize changed files
commands.description: Show a summary of changed files and line counts.

commands.name: Commit staged changes
commands.description: Create a commit from staged changes.

commands.name: Amend the last commit
commands.description: Edit the most recent commit, including its message or staged content.

commands.name: Create an empty commit
commands.description: Create a commit without staged file changes.

commands.name: View compact commit graph
commands.description: Show recent commits as a compact branch graph.

commands.name: View file history
commands.description: Show commits affecting a file, following it across renames.

commands.name: Inspect a commit
commands.description: Show a commit and the changes it introduced.

commands.name: Summarize contributors
commands.description: Count commits by author across branches.

commands.name: Find who changed each line
commands.description: Show the commit and author responsible for each line in a file.

commands.name: Search tracked files
commands.description: Search tracked files for matching text.

commands.name: Show current branch
commands.description: Print the current branch name.

commands.name: List local and remote branches
commands.description: List branches available in the local repository and its remotes.

commands.name: Create a branch
commands.description: Create a branch at the current commit without switching to it.

commands.name: Delete a merged branch
commands.description: Delete a local branch after Git confirms it has been merged.

commands.name: Force delete a branch
commands.description: Force-delete a local branch, including unmerged commits.

commands.name: Switch branches
commands.description: Switch the working tree to an existing branch.

commands.name: Create and switch branch
commands.description: Create a new branch and switch to it.

commands.name: Switch branches (legacy syntax)
commands.description: Switch to an existing branch using the older checkout command.

commands.name: Restore a file from a branch
commands.description: Replace a file with the version from another branch.

commands.name: Merge a branch
commands.description: Merge another branch into the current branch.

commands.name: Abort a merge
commands.description: Stop the current merge and try to restore the pre-merge state.

commands.name: Rebase onto a branch
commands.description: Replay current branch commits on top of another branch.

commands.name: Edit recent commits interactively
commands.description: Reorder, squash, edit, or remove recent commits.

commands.name: Continue a rebase
commands.description: Continue a paused rebase after resolving conflicts.

commands.name: Abort a rebase
commands.description: Cancel the current rebase and restore its starting state.

commands.name: Apply a commit to this branch
commands.description: Apply the changes from an existing commit to the current branch.

commands.name: Revert a commit safely
commands.description: Create a new commit that reverses the changes from another commit.

commands.name: Undo commit, keep staged changes
commands.description: Move the current branch back one commit while keeping changes staged.

commands.name: Undo commit, keep file changes
commands.description: Move the branch back one commit and leave changes unstaged in the working tree.

commands.name: Discard local changes and commits
commands.description: Discard staged and unstaged changes in tracked files.

commands.name: Preview untracked files to clean
commands.description: Preview untracked files and directories that a clean command would remove.

commands.name: Delete untracked files
commands.description: Permanently remove untracked files and directories from the working tree.

commands.name: Stash tracked changes
commands.description: Save tracked working changes temporarily.

commands.name: Stash changes and new files
commands.description: Save tracked changes and untracked files in a stash.

commands.name: List stashes
commands.description: Show saved stashes.

commands.name: Inspect a stash
commands.description: Show the patch stored in the newest stash.

commands.name: Apply a stash and keep it
commands.description: Apply a stash without removing it from the stash list.

commands.name: Apply and remove a stash
commands.description: Apply the newest stash and remove it if the application succeeds.

commands.name: Delete a stash
commands.description: Delete a selected stash entry.

commands.name: List remotes
commands.description: Show remote names and fetch/push URLs.

commands.name: Add a remote
commands.description: Add a named remote repository.

commands.name: Fetch remote updates
commands.description: Download remote refs and remove stale remote-tracking refs.

commands.name: Pull branch updates
commands.description: Fetch and integrate updates from the configured upstream branch.

commands.name: Pull with rebase
commands.description: Fetch updates and replay local commits on top of the upstream branch.

commands.name: Push current branch
commands.description: Send local commits to the configured upstream branch.

commands.name: Publish a new branch
commands.description: Push a branch and set its upstream tracking branch.

commands.name: Safely force-push a branch
commands.description: Update remote history only if it has not changed unexpectedly.

commands.name: Delete a remote branch
commands.description: Delete a branch from the remote repository.

commands.name: List tags
commands.description: List tags in the repository.

commands.name: Create an annotated tag
commands.description: Create an annotated tag for a release or milestone.

commands.name: Push a tag
commands.description: Publish a tag to the remote repository.

commands.name: List worktrees
commands.description: Show working trees attached to this repository.

commands.name: Create a worktree
commands.description: Check out another branch in a separate directory.

commands.name: Remove a worktree
commands.description: Remove a linked working tree directory.

commands.name: Initialize and update submodules
commands.description: Initialize submodules and check out the commits recorded by the project.

commands.name: View recent reference history
commands.description: Inspect recent movements of HEAD and branches to recover commits.

commands.name: Start binary-search debugging
commands.description: Begin finding which commit introduced a bug.
examples: git bisect bad && git bisect good <known-good-commit>

commands.name: End bisect session
commands.description: End bisecting and return to the original branch.

commands.name: Describe current version
commands.description: Show the nearest tag and commit distance for the current commit.

commands.name: Create source archive
commands.description: Create an archive of the repository contents at a commit.
